QuestInfo.1: #b#p3001000##k wants you to speak with #b#p3001002##k about the castle guardians and get his advice on entering the castle.
QuestInfo.2: \nYou met up with #p3001002# and gave him the cookie. Was that happiness on his old face?

0.0: While we reinforce the camp, you can begin preparations to break into the castle. The guards will never expect us to send a lone soldier.
0.1: Be aware, however, of the #rguardians#k defending the castle. There are two that were...originally Novas.
0.2: #rVictor#k and #rTreglow#k... We weren't able to rescue them when we lost our capital. They are now under Magnus's command.
0.3: Get the details from #b#p3001002##k. Oh, and please give him the cookie from last time. I just... HAVE to give him that cookie, you see. If he yet refuses, I might have to burn his house down.\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.0: Excellent. Oh, you might want to speak with #b#p3001001##k here, as well.

no.0: The more we prepare now, the better our chances in the future.
